test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bold word in the following sentence.

His __**eloquent** __speech always persuades people to work for their betterment.
solution:
The correct answer is '**articulate**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**articulate**" means having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently. (स्पष्ट बोलने वाला)
 
• His eloquent speech shows his ability to express his thoughts clearly and effectively.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vague (अस्पष्ट)**: means unclear or not clearly expressed.
 
• **Inarticulate (असंगत)**: means unable to express one's thoughts or feelings clearly.
 
• **Short (छोटा)**: means having a small distance from end to end.
